backtest_protocol.execution_model: Existing accepted allocator source rows are built through the accepted helper. Revision rows are built by the same shared allocator helper using the accepted revision-surprise low-extension historical function at fixed rank 5 before the fixed top1/day allocator.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus shared default-off revision source-family extension over the accepted helper source-priority allocator

hypothesis: Accepted revision-surprise low-extension paper rows may add independent replacement value when admitted as a fixed source family into the accepted helper source-priority allocator, because PIT analyst revision/surprise evidence is orthogonal to pure OHLCV helper rows.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by changing revision source rank, revision helper thresholds, allocator top-N, notional, hold days, or cooldown on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs closed forward allocator displacement rows, vendor-grade PIT analyst revision provenance, or a materially different expectation trajectory field such as analyst-count or dispersion change.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The revision rows added replacement value on dates where expectation revision evidence displaced pure OHLCV rows or supplied coverage on dates where the higher-priority helpers had weaker candidates. The shared helper now owns the same source admission, so historical replay and daily default-off snapshots use the same policy bundle.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate-pool/allocation alpha: accepted revision-surprise low-extension rows may add an orthogonal expectation data source to the accepted source-priority allocator.

2_history_check.exp-20260609-011: Accepted revision-surprise low-extension shared helper: aggregate EV +0.1846 and PnL +$2,893.75 across all three windows.
2_history_check.exp-20260610-005: Accepted source-priority allocator without revision source: aggregate EV +0.8971 and PnL +$14,502.52. This is the binding comparator.
2_history_check.exp-20260610-006: Rejected macro-relief source extension: positive versus core but did not beat the accepted allocator comparator.
2_history_check.exp-20260610-009: Rejected 52-week source extension: high aggregate EV but at least one accepted-allocator window comparator regressed.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Must improve aggregate EV/PnL, have no EV/PnL regression windows, satisfy sample/survival/drawdown/concentration guards, and beat exp-20260610-005 aggregate and per-window EV/PnL comparator.

prediction.confidence_reason: The source-priority allocator is the strongest current accepted default-off lane, and the revision-surprise helper passed all three windows with non-OHLCV expectation information. Recent macro and 52-week source extensions failed by displacing better rows, so success depends on revision rows being genuinely orthogonal and improving every canonical window versus the accepted allocator comparator.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: source snapshot failures are represented in allocator source coverage and do not place orders
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; allocator stays default-off until a separate activation experiment
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: revision helper requires price, volume, close-location, and average dollar-volume gates before next-open paper entry
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation envelope pass

production_impact.parity_note: The revision source-family admission is implemented in the shared default-off allocator helper and daily snapshot wiring. It remains observe-only: no live/default orders, core signals, candidate ranking, sizing, exits, watchlist, LLM, or news path are changed.
